title: color-map scale
description: Build a color scale from a seed color: a preset, a Radix-style brand scale, or contrast targets

seed.description: The color the scale is built around

steps.description: Steps of an even scale; replaces --preset

brand.description: Build a 12-step UI scale where the seed is step 9 exactly

background.description: The background: page color for --brand, or what --targets are measured against

targets.description: Contrast ratios, one per step, such as 3,4.5,7: builds a contrast scale

gamut.description: The gamut every step must fit

full.description: Show the complete output instead of truncating it
